name: Trance Kiss
source: A collaboration between Visual Art's and Betsucomi's best-selling author Nana Shiiba. An adaptation of the one-shot of the same name published in Deluxe Betsucomi in February 2005.
translation: 由Visual Art's与《Betsucomi》的人气漫画家椎叶ナナ合作推出。改编自2005年2月发表于《Deluxe Betsucomi》的同名单篇漫画。
